notes: The empty Telemetry panel now says something, loudly. It read "Pick a session on the left." in small grey text in the middle of a large dark panel; it now reads START DRIVING, OR PICK A SESSION ON THE LEFT in the condensed brand face, bold, uppercase and up to 32 px instead of 13 - and it leads with the thing you are most likely to want to do. The Setups panel empty state gets the same treatment. Everything from 0.9.166 is included: the Corners window layout at 3 turns (the label column could grow wider than the panel, putting the GEAR caption on the B/A/G headers and pushing the lights off the edge), the GEAR caption right-aligned to the gear column so it cannot collide and still shows at the default width, the Stint window turns button now actually drawn rather than being an invisible click target, and a share opt-out on the debrief path. All eight fixes from 0.9.165 were re-verified in the shipped build.
